glossary.dataset: A table is analysable data that KPubData creates from source datasets and manages as one unit. Each refresh adds a new snapshot.
glossary.build: The job that collects and processes data from the sources and settings you chose.
glossary.run: One recorded execution that creates or refreshes a table and produces a snapshot. A table can have many runs.
glossary.buildSpec: The portable execution spec telling KPubData Builder which sources to fetch and how to process them.
glossary.provider: An external data source or API that KPubData Builder can connect to.
glossary.credential: Authentication such as an API key, needed to fetch data from a provider.
glossary.preview: A look at part of the data and its validation results before you create or refresh a table.
glossary.bronze: The stage that keeps collected data as close to the original as possible.
glossary.silver: The stage where bronze data is cleaned and standardized for analysis and quality checks.
glossary.gold: The final stage, shaped for a particular use.
glossary.quality: The results of the data quality rules KPubData Builder actually evaluated.
glossary.schemaDrift: A change in data structure — columns added, removed or retyped — compared with before.
glossary.evidence: The KPubData Builder table, run and quality facts an Ask KPubData answer or report is based on.
glossary.context: The table, run, source and stage scope Ask KPubData uses to interpret your question.
glossary.generatedSql: The query SQL Ask KPubData generated from the silver or gold schema you selected.
glossary.artifact: Snapshot files are the data files and other outputs a run saves in its snapshot.
glossary.manifest: The metadata record of a run and the snapshot files it produced.
glossary.readiness: KPubData Builder's check of the conditions that must hold before publishing.

quality.pass: No problem found in the rules that were evaluated
quality.warn: A result exists but there is a quality issue worth checking
quality.fail: A quality rule was not met
quality.na: No value was evaluated or the rule does not apply. Not a PASS
quality.unavailable: KPubData Builder cannot provide a result. Different from FAIL

users.confirmReject: Reject {{name}}? KPubData Builder refuses their requests from then on, even if an allowlist admits them.
users.decisionForbidden: KPubData Builder refused this decision (403). Only an administrator can approve or reject a sign-up.
users.decisionNotFound: KPubData Builder has no user {{name}} (404). The list may be out of date.

analyses.title: Saved Analyses
analyses.desc: SQL kept with the snapshot it read, so running it again reads the same input after a refresh.
analyses.noWarehouse: Saving analyses needs a KPubData Builder with a warehouse; this deployment has none, so SQL Workspace queries runs directly and cannot save.
analyses.emptyDesc: Run a query in SQL Workspace and save it with a name.
analyses.confirmDelete: Delete "{{name}}"? Its snapshot is no longer kept for it.
analyses.saved: Saved "{{name}}" with the snapshot it read.

dataTable.truncated: Truncated — cut at the limit. Unless the query ordered it, this is not the "top N"
dataTable.pinned: Snapshot {{snapshot}} pinned — the next pages read the same snapshot

charts.title: Chart
charts.additive: This column may be added up (needed for a sum)
charts.noMeasure: No column can be drawn as a number — identifier (code) columns are text, not measures.
charts.missingCount: {{count}} with no value — drawn as gaps, not 0

scope.topN: Top {{returned}} by {{order}} — of {{total}} groups. Aggregated over every row
scope.truncated: Based on the {{count}} rows returned — a cut result: not the whole, not the top N, not a sample

export.title: Export the result
export.note: KPubData Builder writes the file — it pins the snapshot, checks the source's terms and PII policy, and refuses a result over the row or size limit instead of cutting it. Studio never builds a result file itself.
export.bomNote: A BOM only makes Excel read UTF-8. It does not stop leading zeros, large integers or dates from being converted. Cells that start like a formula get a leading ' and are counted.
export.coverageUnknown: Fetch coverage: not recorded (unknown, not complete)
export.derived: A result derived by your query
export.termsUnknown: not confirmed ({{status}}) — check the source before redistributing

refused.license: The source's licence forbids changes (e.g. KOGL type 3 or 4), so it cannot be exported. Nothing was kept.
refused.pii: Refused: values the PII policy does not let out: {{findings}}. Nothing was kept.
refused.limit: Refused: over the row or size limit. Results are not cut, so nothing was kept — narrow the query or raise the limit.

statusState.missing: KPubData Builder did not provide this value
statusState.axesMissing: Table status: not provided by KPubData Builder

runView.noWarehouse: This deployment has no warehouse, so the table is shown by run.
runView.noSnapshot: This table has no committed snapshot yet, so it is shown by run.

errors.table: Could not load the table's snapshots
errors.runs: Could not load the run history.

tableDetail.notCommittedDesc: This source table has not been committed yet. It shows here once a refresh finishes.
